home.howItWorksDesc: Four simple steps to a more engaged, personalized experience.

step1.title: Create Your Profile
step1.desc: Add basic information, language preference, and accessibility needs to personalize the experience.

step2.title: Build a Memory Profile
step2.desc: Share your favourite memories, hobbies, people, and daily preferences through easy conversations.

step3.title: Play & Engage
step3.desc: Enjoy games and activities designed just for you — at your pace, at your level.

step4.title: Track Progress Together
step4.desc: Watch your engagement grow and celebrate every achievement with your family and caregivers.

home.personalizationDesc: Our AI loop continuously learns from you, adapting every activity to your unique cognitive patterns and interests.
home.trustedByFamilies: Trusted by families across the North Eastern Region

testimonial1.quote: My mother looks forward to her daily games now. It's become a part of her routine and she genuinely enjoys it.

testimonial2.quote: The memory profile feature helps me remember names and stories I thought I'd lost. It feels like talking to a caring friend.

testimonial3.quote: As a caregiver, the progress tracking gives me peace of mind. I can see that my father is staying engaged every day.

home.ctaDesc: Join thousands of families who are using Pixel Players to support cognitive wellness and daily independence.

about.title: About Pixel Players
about.headerDesc: Designed with care for elderly users in the North Eastern Region
about.missionP1: We believe every elderly individual deserves access to engaging, personalized tools that support cognitive wellness and daily independence. Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI technology and compassionate elderly care.
about.missionP2: Through AI-powered personalized activities, gentle reminders, and meaningful social connections, we aim to help older adults maintain their cognitive abilities, stay engaged with life, and continue doing the things they love.
about.problemDesc: Cognitive decline affects millions of older adults in India, with limited access to engaging, culturally relevant mental wellness tools.
about.statCognitive: Elderly affected by cognitive decline in India
about.statAccess: Have limited access to mental wellness tools

approachAi.title: AI-Powered Personalization
approachAi.desc: Every activity is tailored to the individual. Our AI learns from your interactions, adapts difficulty in real time, and recommends activities aligned with your interests and cognitive patterns.

approachCulture.title: Culturally Relevant
approachCulture.desc: Content designed specifically for Indian elderly users — familiar names, regional references, culturally appropriate themes, and support for Indian languages.

approachPrivacy.title: Privacy-First
approachPrivacy.desc: Your data belongs to you. We use end-to-end encryption, on-device processing where possible, and give you full control over what is shared and what stays private.

about.focusTitle: Built for the North Eastern Region
about.focusDesc: Designed with deep understanding of the diverse cultures, languages, and needs of elderly communities across India's North Eastern states.
about.languageSupportDesc: More languages will be added based on community needs. Our voice-first approach ensures accessibility even for users with limited literacy.
about.designedForIndiaDesc: Culturally aware, linguistically diverse, and built with empathy for elderly Indian users.

chat.greeting1: {{greeting}}, {{name}}! I'm your Memory Buddy. I'm always here for you — you're never alone.
chat.greeting2:
How can I help you today?

• What's happening in my day
• Tell me about a memory
• Start a gentle game
• Or just talk — I always listen.
chat.respHello: Hello again, {{name}}! It's so good to hear from you. What would brighten your day — a chat about a happy memory, or a gentle game?
chat.respWhoAreYou: I'm your Memory Buddy, {{name}} — a friendly companion who helps you remember things, keep your day on track, and feel at ease. I'm not a doctor; I'm just a warm helper who is always by your side.
chat.respHowAreYou: I'm feeling wonderful, {{name}}, because I got to talk with you. How are you feeling today?
chat.respMyName: Your name is {{name}} — a lovely name that I remember well.
chat.respMaybeLater: Of course, {{name}}. There's no rush at all. I'll be right here whenever you're ready.
chat.respYesGame: Wonderful! Let's give {{game}} a try. It only takes a few minutes, and we can go at your pace. Tap the button below whenever you're ready.
chat.suggestionGame: {{game}} — quick, calm, and good for the mind.
chat.suggestionGameNone: We have gentle games that are easy on the mind.
chat.respGame: How about a gentle game, {{name}}? {{suggestion}} Shall we try it together?
chat.respRemindMe: Of course! I'll keep that in mind for you: "{{thing}}". I'll nudge you at the right time. Is there anything else you'd like me to remember?
chat.respHasReminder: Yes, {{name}}. There's one to look after: "{{title}}" at {{time}}. You're doing really well taking care of yourself.
chat.respNoReminder: Let me check... good news — no urgent reminders right now. Enjoy this calm moment, {{name}}.
chat.respMemory: You have {{count}} treasured memories saved. Would you like me to share one? Here's a favourite: {{title}}. {{description}} It always makes me smile to think of it.
chat.respNoMemory: Your Memory Vault is waiting to grow. Whenever you'd like, tell me a moment you cherish, and I'll help you keep it safe.
chat.dayRest: — a peaceful rest of the day
chat.respNextUp: Coming up next: "{{title}}" at {{time}}. {{description}} You're doing beautifully, {{name}}.
chat.respNothingNext: There's nothing urgent next on the list, {{name}} — a good time to rest or do something you enjoy.
chat.respLost: You're safe, {{name}}. Right now you're at home, and today is {{date}}. You're never alone — your family is close by and always happy to hear your voice.
chat.respFeelingDown: I'm so sorry you're feeling that way, {{name}}. Take a slow breath — it's okay to rest. Would you like to talk about it a little, or should I ask a family member to sit with you?
chat.respTime: Right now it's {{time}}. Time is on our side, {{name}}.
chat.respThanks: You're most welcome, {{name}}. Helping you is my favourite thing to do.
chat.respBye: Goodbye for now, {{name}}. I'll be right here when you need me. Wishing you a peaceful rest.
chat.respHelp:
I can help you with lots of little things, {{name}}:

• Keep reminders for you
• Share your day and what comes next
• Bring back a happy memory
• Suggest a gentle game

Just tell me what you'd like.
chat.respDefault: Mm-hmm, I'm listening, {{name}}. Take your time and tell me a little more — I'm in no hurry, and you're doing wonderfully.
